description: This file contains the implementation of a Smarty plugin, specifically a modifier plugin named 'default'. It generates PHP code to apply a default value for variables if they are empty or null, used within Smarty templates to handle default values.

methods.name: smarty_modifiercompiler_default
methods.description: Generates PHP code for Smarty's 'default' modifier, returning PHP code that assigns a default value to a variable if the original variable is null or empty.
